implementation_statement: Compensating control (one-person business): the owner is the only administrator of the owner's own tools, so the audit records relied on are held by the providers and the city. The owner cannot alter provider or city logs; only administrators of those systems can read them (P03 G-030). The owner reviews them each month under POL-01 7.7.

Compensating control (one-person business): the owner designed, operates, and assessed the controls, and P07 states that independence is limited. The IT technician helped run the tests under NDA, and the city facilities manager witnessed the library controller test. A summary of the POA&M goes to the city IT manager. Gap: no independent review yet. Action: outside review at least every second year (POL-01 4.5), first by 2027-08-31 (P03 G-034). Base CA-2 is the August self-assessment.
evidence: P07 assessment-plan.md (independence statement); POL-01 4.5; P03 G-034
